limits: Novel-vs-base prior assumed; current initial four classes no justified external rich-base partition.
Empirical per-dataset alpha/beta/K/gamma/tau; no query tuning permitted here. Nsyn and precise lambda numeric not found in inspected implementation text.
Packed float64 Gram alone K3000=36012000/K5000=100020000bytes >19058800; anchor features and class covariance additional.
Cauchy-Schwarz/concentration do not alone prove class-conditional strict separation or population minority benefit; identical input with different label has identical kernel embedding.
Original pipeline includes supervised base adaptation; cannot call fully zero-training.
DAP.decision: No DAP run, no resizing anchors/diagonal covariance/pseudobase split to rename stopped kernel/covariance routes.
